name: codex-appearance-companion
description: Unofficial Codex appearance companion with experimental standalone desktop editors

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.cjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s test -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.format: prettier --write src desktop/*.cjs desktop/*.json scripts/*.cjs test/*.cjs *.json *.md .github/**/*.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src desktop/*.cjs desktop/*.json scripts/*.cjs test/*.cjs *.json *.md .github/**/*.yml
